messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: CmdStan is now at 2.8.0
parts:
On Saturday, September 19, 2015 at 8:30:46 PM UTC-4, Daniel Lee wrote:
I'm going to announce it on stan-users and stan-announce, but I'll hold off on posting to the blog until RStan and PyStan are ready.

RStan is on CRAN but the binaries are not built / mirrored out yet. And, I'm going to have to upload a 2.8.0-1 that works around this undefined behavior in Eigen with the csr_ stuff

http://www.stats.ox.ac.uk/pub/bdr/memtests/gcc-UBSAN/rstan/tests/doRUnit.Rout

But really, we need an announcement about Stan Math 2.8.0 since very little changed in the interfaces.

Ben

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: CmdStan is now at 2.8.0
parts:
On Sunday, September 20, 2015 at 11:05:16 AM UTC-4, Ben Goodrich wrote:
On Saturday, September 19, 2015 at 8:30:46 PM UTC-4, Daniel Lee wrote:
I'm going to announce it on stan-users and stan-announce, but I'll hold off on posting to the blog until RStan and PyStan are ready.

RStan is on CRAN but the binaries are not built / mirrored out yet. And, I'm going to have to upload a 2.8.0-1 that works around this undefined behavior in Eigen with the csr_ stuff

http://www.stats.ox.ac.uk/pub/bdr/memtests/gcc-UBSAN/rstan/tests/doRUnit.Rout

BTW, the problem can be reproduced in Stan Math with

./runTests.py test/unit/math/prim/mat/fun/csr_extract_v_test.cpp

if make/local includes

CC=g++ -g -fsanitize=undefined

or possibly a recent clang++.

Ben

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: CmdStan is now at 2.8.0
parts:
On Sunday, September 20, 2015 at 1:30:25 PM UTC-4, Krzysztof Sakrejda wrote:
That's useful, it looks (based on a quick search) like Google Test requires everything to be compiled with the same options so I don't think we can just turn this on for code that touches pointers but it would've been useful to catch this earlier.  I'll check mid-week what this is about if nobody else gets to it by then.

It seems to be minor, fixed in the next version of Eigen, and something for RcppEigen to cherry-pick

https://forum.kde.org/viewtopic.php?f=74&t=126346

but I think we can work around it in the meantime by implementing extract_sparse_parts with R code only.

Ben
